title: Navigate Your File System
description: Learn to navigate files and folders like a pro using your file explorer.

steps.instruction: Open your file explorer (Finder on Mac, File Explorer on Windows)
hints: Look for the Finder icon in your dock (the smiling face)
You can also press Cmd+Space and type 'Finder'
In Finder, look at the sidebar on the left for 'Documents'

steps.instruction: Create a new folder called 'Z-RO Practice'
hints: Right-click in the empty space and select 'New Folder'

overlay.text: Right-click > New Folder, then name it 'Z-RO Practice'

steps.instruction: Confirm you can see the 'Z-RO Practice' folder in Documents
hints: You should see the new folder in the file list
